source_message.speaker: client
source_message.text:
Hi Abdulbari,

This rendering made me feel really excited. We are getting so incredibly close! Beautiful work, Abdulbari—truly.

After sitting with them for a while, I think Option B is the strongest direction. It has the confidence, restraint, and architectural quality I was hoping for.

Option A feels a little too sharp to me, while Option C has a softness that I like, but I think Option B captures the overall character best.

For the next round, I'd love to explore just a few very subtle refinements while keeping everything else exactly as it is:

1\. Start with Option B and extend the right arm of the Hero V ever so slightly—just a touch more reach while maintaining the exact same slope and geometry. Please carry that same refinement through the second V and the É accent. This should be an extremely subtle change. It might actually be helpful to include a horizontal reference line so I can clearly see how much higher the right arm extends above the left arm. I think this difference will ultimately become one of the defining characteristics shared by the Hero V, second V, and É accent.

2\. Starting from that same version of Option B, keep the identical amount of reach, but soften the terminal ever so slightly. I'm not looking for more curvature—just a gentler finish while preserving the same architectural character. Perhaps the corners become just a touch softer, but the tip itself remains straight rather than curving.

3\. Take Option C and give it that same subtle increase in reach, again keeping the slope and overall geometry unchanged, and apply it consistently to the Hero V, second V, and É accent.

At this point, I think we're working in very small refinements. I'd like to keep the overall architecture locked and simply explore these final nuances.

Thank you again—I’m so excited to see the result!
